description: This file is a shell script designed to test 'git apply' functionality with various scenarios such as file renames, mode changes, symlinks, binary files, and directories. It sets up a git repository, makes specific changes, and verifies that 'git apply' correctly handles complex patch scenarios related to type changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the given commands, and checks the result.

methods.name: test_debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information, primarily to display the current patch being applied.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
